name: Murder Masquerade
storyline: In Murder Masquerade, the players make and uncover the story through our 'Investigation' mechanic which uncovers pieces of evidence that gradually uncover the method, motive, and culprit of the murder. The game is designed to simulate a murder mystery party, where the players themselves are part of the story.
summary: Murder Masquerade is a story-driven Social Deduction game where the killer hides among the suspects, and even the innocents may bend the truth to frame or protect the others. Developed with love and intrigue by Pojpo, an indie game studio.
